name: Salzgitter AG
summary: Salzgitter AG, together with its subsidiaries, engages in steel and technology businesses worldwide. The company operates through four segments: Steel Production, Steel Processing, Trading, and Technology. Its Steel Production segment manufactures steel and special steels, such as hot-rolled wide strip, steel sheet, sections, tailored blanks, as well as scrap trading. The Steel Processing segment produces various high-grade heavy plate products; and manufactures line pipes, HFI-welded tubes, and precision tubes.
